title: Order a family history certificate
summary: This page provides instructions on how to apply for a family history certificate from the Registry of Births Deaths & Marriages.
intro:
The Registry of Births Deaths & Marriages holds early church records from 1788 to 1855, and records of birth, death and marriage registrations from 1856.

You can apply for a family history certificate, once a set amount of time has elapsed:
who_can_apply: The application can be made once a set amount of time has elapsed.
what_you_need: Family name/s and the date range of the event

how_to_steps.text: Select the event you want to search for.
If you know the registration number, enter it. If you don't, fill in at least one name field and the date range.
Check the box next to the certificate you want to purchase, and select 'Add to order'.
Choose the delivery method from the drop-down menu and select 'Update Order'.
Download and complete the Application for a Family History Certificate – PDF.
Submit according to the instructions on the form.

more_info.text: If you change your mind, or decide the certificate is no longer required, your application fee will not be refunded.

faqs.q: What types of records are available?
faqs.a: The Registry of Births Deaths & Marriages holds early church records from 1788 to 1855, and records of birth, death and marriage registrations from 1856.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for a certificate?
faqs.a: You need your personal details, payment, family name/s and the date range of the event, and the registration number if you know it.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a family history certificate?
faqs.a: You can apply by selecting 'Apply online', following the steps to search for the certificate, adding it to your order, and completing the purchase and application form.
